titre: OPSYS-AI · Votre entreprise, au complet (film de vision)
idee: Pendant que vous êtes sur le toit, dix départements préparent tout ; rien ne part sans votre décision.

toit.image: Sunrise on a snowy suburban roof in Quebec: a roofing and gutter contractor in his forties, insulated work jacket, gloves and toque, kneels on the roof edge fitting a white aluminum gutter; his breath is visible; his phone in the chest pocket lights up and vibrates; he pauses and looks down at it. Bright golden sunrise key light, clean pale blue sky, crisp snow, lifted shadows, natural skin texture, 35mm.
toit.mouvement: Slow push-in; he stops working, glances at the glowing phone in his pocket, then keeps his hands on the gutter, looking out at the street.
toit.son: Cold morning wind, a phone vibrating in a jacket, distant traffic, a metal gutter clink.

marteau.image: Gloved hands hammering a nail into roof shingles in the cold morning light.
marteau.mouvement: Slow push-in on the gloved hands at work.

soir.image: Evening at home: a father sits on the floor by a window playing with his young child in warm lamplight.
soir.son: Soft home ambience, a child's laugh.

matin.image: Sunrise: the contractor stands on a rooftop looking over a small Quebec town, golden light.

plans.sous: Dix départements. Une seule entreprise : la vôtre.

narration.texte: Quand vous êtes sur le toit… qui répond?
OPSYS-AI. Dix départements, chacun avec ses agents.
narration.dit: Opsis A I. Dix départements, chacun avec ses agents.

narration.texte: L'appel devient un dossier. Le dossier, une soumission. La job finie, une facture.
Tout est préparé. C'est vous qui décidez.
Et le matin, votre briefing est prêt.

musique.prompt: A 60-second cinematic instrumental for a premium, Apple-style vision film about a Quebec roofing contractor whose company runs ten AI departments. Grounded, warm, hopeful and precise. 0-6 s: near silence, cold air, one low piano note. 6-30 s: a steady soft pulse at 84 BPM (felt piano ostinato, low strings, a subtle heartbeat kick) that builds step by step, each step a little brighter. 30-35 s: the music breathes out, intimate and tender (evening at home). 35-44 s: a confident, luminous rise with full strings and warm percussion. 44-55 s: one sustained resolved chord and a clean ending by 56 s. No vocals, no choir, no bombast, no risers.
